Implement Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion staggered reveals.
Create an interactive Canvas or R3F/Three.js hero accent element for tactical automotive aesthetic.
Ensure all phone buttons open `tel:5015996910` and directions link opens Google Maps with full address.
